title: Sunset Sessions at Anjuna
summary: An open-air evening of live sets, sea breeze, and a slow Goa sunset.
description:
Doors open an hour before sundown so guests can settle in with a drink and watch the sky change over the Arabian Sea. A rotating line-up of local musicians plays through the evening, with a relaxed dance floor and plenty of space to sit by the water. Food stalls serve Goan favourites through the night.

This is an enquiry-only listing: share your group size and preferred date and our team will confirm availability, seating, and pricing on WhatsApp.
highlights: Live sunset set from local musicians
Goan food stalls and a cash bar

title: Moonlit Mangrove Night Market
summary: A lantern-lit market along the Mandovi with food, craft stalls, and acoustic sets.
description:
The riverside path turns into a small night market after dark: lanterns in the mangroves, stalls from Goa-based makers, and acoustic sets between the trees. It is an easy, walk-around evening rather than a seated concert, so guests can drift between food, shopping, and music.

Entry is arranged through our team. Tell us how many people are coming and we will share the current availability and any minimum spend for the evening.

title: Beachside Anniversary Celebration
summary: A private beachfront evening for anniversaries, birthdays, and family milestones.
description:
A flexible private celebration set up on the sand: a decorated table, a short menu chosen with you, and space for speeches and photographs. We plan the layout around your guest count, from a table for eight to a full beach section for a larger family gathering.

Share your date, headcount, and any dietary needs. We will come back with a simple plan and a quote on WhatsApp. No online payment is taken here.

title: Heritage Walk & Folk Evening
summary: A guided walk through Panaji's Latin Quarter, ending with a folk music evening.
description:
Start with a slow walk through the lanes of Fontainhas, stopping at painted houses, small chapels, and neighbourhood bakeries. The evening closes in a restored courtyard with a short folk performance and a Goan dinner.

The walk is limited to small groups so the neighbourhood stays comfortable. Ask us about the next available date and we will hold places for your party.
highlights: Goan dinner to close the evening

title: Cliffside Vow Renewal Showcase
summary: An intimate cliffside setting for vow renewals and small wedding ceremonies.
description:
A quiet ceremony setup above the water, with a simple arch, seated guests, and space for a photographer to work without crowding the moment. The format suits vow renewals and small weddings of up to forty guests.

We coordinate the setup, timing, and local permissions. Send us your preferred date and guest count and we will explain what is possible for the season.
highlights: Cliffside ceremony for up to 40 guests

title: Team Offsite by the Arabian Sea
summary: A one-day team offsite with meeting space, a beach break, and an evening dinner.
description:
Built for teams that want to mix work and breathing room: a morning session in an air-conditioned hall, an afternoon on the sand, and a relaxed dinner to close. We can arrange transport from Panaji or the airport and keep the schedule flexible.

Tell us your team size, preferred month, and any session requirements. We will put together an outline and pricing for your review.
